title: Loop Heat Pipe
definition: A loop heat pipe is a sealed two-phase thermal-transport device driven by capillary pressure rather than a mechanical pump. Its primary wick sits in the evaporator. Heat vaporises working fluid at the wick surface; vapour passes through a dedicated line to the condenser; liquid returns through a separate line and compensation chamber. The physical separation of vapour and liquid paths permits routing and transport distances that are difficult for a conventional heat pipe.[^1][^2]
